question.text:
Consider the following reaction sequence
Compound (x)\[\begin{array}{l}\text{(i) } \mathrm{CO}_{2}, \mathrm{NaOH}, 120^{\circ}\mathrm{C}, \\ \text{high pressure}\end{array}\]
\[\begin{array}{c}\text{(ii) } \mathrm{H}_{3}\mathrm{O}^{+} \\ {[76.6\% \mathrm{C}, 6.38\% \mathrm{H},} \\ \text{vapour density 47]}\end{array}\]

$\begin{gathered}\text { Compound (y) } \\ \text { (Major Product) }\end{gathered}$
Compound $(\mathrm{y})$ develops characteristic colour with neutral $\mathrm{FeCl}_{3}$ solution. Identify the INCORRECT statement from the following for the above sequence.

options.text: Compound y will dissolve in $\mathrm{NaHCO}_{3}$ and evolve a gas.
Both compounds $x$ and $y$ will dissolve in NaOH.
Both compounds $x$ and $y$ will burn with sooty flame.
Compound x is more acidic than compound y.
